title: Loneliness = 15 cigarettes a day
_syntax: [Klammern] = Akzentfarbe mit Textur (nur in headline). **Sterne** = fett in bullets/body. Zeilenumbruch = eigener Array-Eintrag; du bestimmst den Umbruch, nicht der Renderer. `alt` pro Slide ist Pflicht — Buffer verlangt altText beim Upload.
_caption_syntax: Caption-Formel aus dem Playbook, 6 Bloecke: kern (1-2 Saetze + 2 Emojis) · detail (Zahlen, Namen, Daten) · kontext (was es bedeutet) · frage (an die Leser) · sources (PFLICHT) · hashtags (genau 5). Bloecke mit Leerzeile getrennt posten.

caption.kern: Loneliness doesn't just feel bad. It shows up in mortality data — at roughly the scale of smoking 15 cigarettes a day. 🚬💔
caption.detail: In 2010 Julianne Holt-Lunstad and her team at Brigham Young University pooled 148 separate studies covering 308,849 people. Those with strong social relationships had a 50% higher likelihood of surviving the follow-up period. Odds ratio: 1.50.
caption.kontext: Converted onto the risk axis tobacco researchers use, that gap sits at around 15 cigarettes a day. It was larger than the effect of physical inactivity, and larger than the effect of obesity — the two things we build entire industries around.
caption.frage: Who is the person you would call at 3am?
caption.sources: Sources: Holt-Lunstad, Smith & Layton — Social relationships and mortality risk: a meta-analytic review • PLOS Medicine 7(7): e1000316, July 2010 • doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1000316
